verdict.rationale: Adyen's platform docs explicitly support splitting each transaction and deducting fees/costs per user (docs-2, docs-10, docs-22), marketing copy confirms fee control as a competitive/revenue lever (docs-16), and Adyen provides generated reports for bookkeeping/reconciliation of platform funds (docs-5). This covers per-transaction fee/markup capture and per-seller split configuration with reporting for revenue reconciliation. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a dedicated 'platform revenue' vs 'processing cost' report line item, and concrete UI/dashboard evidence of per-seller differentiated pricing rules beyond generic split configuration.
